digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot / code-review criterion execution
propositions: A deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the project.review-phase-boundaries criterion through its full four-pass pipeline on a real Gerrit change to prove end-to-end execution; offline mocks cannot validate repository-resolution behavior.

An advisory-only dogfood probe with four sequential patchsets must demonstrate that the criterion correctly identifies review-phase directives without blocking, then clean the final revision to leave only valid instructions on main.
The positive-control patchset must produce an empty verdict (no project-attributed finding) when the criterion discovers and grounds a valid phase-boundary refinement in Pass-1.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries, criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], Pass-2 validity and impact, and Pass-3 decision=advisory with block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false.
The configuration block_threshold=0.90 and blocking_enabled=false must remain unchanged before, during, and after the probe; blocking promotion is deferred to a future data-backed ticket.

The final submitted patchset (PS4) must contain only the valid positive-control refinement, no FIRE directive, and must land on main without any project-criterion findings; historical PS2 abstention and PS3 proof must be preserved in Gerrit as audit trail.
